subject: Duplicate marketplace charges — urgent usage audit & legal hold
messages:
From: Billing Team <billing@plutosoft.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: PlutoSoft Legal <legal@plutosoft.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Duplicate marketplace charges — urgent usage audit & legal hold

Hi Nikhil,

We discovered duplicate charge lines on our August marketplace invoice (attached). Two separate listings under our org ID were billed for the same usage window and instance IDs: line items 4821 and 4821-dup. The gross amount in question is $72,410.

We need Redwood to: 
- Acknowledge receipt and place a legal hold on payout for the disputed amount immediately.
- Provide raw metering logs (per-listing, per-instance) for 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31.
- Confirm whether there were duplicate listings or an ingestion/replication bug on your side.

Attachments: PluToSoft_invoice_2026-08-dup.pdf (pdf), preliminary_suspect_lines.csv (csv)

We'd like to start an audit this week. Please confirm next steps and a primary contact.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Billing Manager
PlutoSoft Inc.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Billing Team <billing@plutosoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Duplicate marketplace charges — urgent usage audit & legal hold

Sanjay — thanks for flagging this and sending the invoice. I've opened an internal investigation and put a temporary legal hold on the payout line for the listed amount. Marissa (sales lead for PlutoSoft) and Laura (marketplace ops) are looped in.

To help us triage, can you confirm the specific listing IDs (the CSV you attached is helpful) and whether you see duplicate listing GUIDs in your portal? We will extract per-instance metering logs for the full month and share a checksum'ed archive by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will request per-listing metering logs from our marketplace ingestion team (ETA 24-36h).
2) Marissa will surface the publisher/listing history and any recent relists or transfers.
3) We will freeze payout for the disputed lines and prepare a credit memo draft pending audit.

I acknowledge legal hold request — please have your legal team send a short statement (email is fine) with the retention window you're requesting. We'll preserve ingestion records and metering snapshots.

- Nikhil
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick note from finance:

1) If the audit confirms duplication and we issue a credit, we need to know whether PlutoSoft reports VAT on gross invoices or net-of-credit. That determines how we draft the credit memo and whether we need to refile any VAT reporting for August. Please confirm your VAT stance.
2) For the payout hold: we can place the $72,410 on a short-term reserve (21 days) while the audit runs. If the audit goes beyond that, we'll need a formal request from your legal team to extend the hold.

Action items for PlutoSoft: legal confirmation on retention & VAT stance.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Duplicate marketplace charges — action plan and timelines

Team — thanks for the rapid responses. Quick summary and action plan: 

1) Evidence collection (complete): ingestion snapshots & meter logs for 2026-08 (file: plutosoft-metering-snapshot-202608.zip) — uploaded to secure ops link: https://app.redwood.ai/ops/12345-audit-request (read-only link provided to PlutoSoft legal).
2) Preliminary finding: ingestion history shows a relist event on 2026-08-14 that created two active listing entries that pointed to the same backend instance IDs. No duplicate usage recorded at the hypervisor layer — the duplication is at listing/metadata layer.
3) Payout hold: Redwood will reserve $72,410 for 21 days starting 2026-09-07. If PlutoSoft's signed legal confirmation extends the hold, we will keep funds in reserve until the agreed date.
4) Credit memo: draft attached (credit-memo-draft.pdf). If you confirm acceptance we will route a DocuSign for signature.
5) Next steps for engineering: Laura will open a ticket with ingestion engineering to remove the phantom listing and add a guard to prevent relist->duplicate mapping. ETA for patch: 10 business days.

PlutoSoft action items: 
- Send signed legal confirmation for 90-day preservation if you require it (Anya).
- Confirm acceptance of proposed credit memo flow (billing team).
- Confirm if you want the credit issued gross or net (VAT treatment) — per Anya's note, you report net-of-credits.

I'll keep this thread updated and will share the DocuSign link once Marissa confirms the final credit amount.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
